chapter: Technique, New Orleans influence and the school's future
title: How travel changed Punch Miller
summary: Allen asks whether travel changed Punch; DeVore says Punch's playing is now very different from his early records.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: What about somebody like Punch who's traveled a lot and been away more or less since the 20s? Do you think it changed his philosophy or his style?

Oh yeah, I think it changed Punch a lot. I think Punch from the records that I've heard of Punch is so completely different than what he plays now. He wouldn't know it was the same guy. I mean even the tone. I wonder, I'm just curious if that's what would happen to all normal musicians if they had to go and travel and play with different styles of bands.
